exposure: High dose oxytocin (80 units in 500cc Ringer's solution infused over 30 minutes)
Normal dose oxytocin (30 units in 500cc Ringer's solution infused over 30 minutes)
outcome: Decline of hemoglobin 6 and 24 hours after cesarean section
cohort: 150 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section in Zahedan, Iran
finding: High dose oxytocin infusion (80 units) was associated with a lower incidence of uterine atony and need for extra uterotonic drugs compared to normal dose oxytocin (30 units), while there was no significant difference in decline of hemoglobin levels between the groups.
mod_finding: High dose oxytocin infusion (80 units) was associated with a lower incidence of uterine atony and need for extra uterotonic drugs compared to normal dose oxytocin (30 units).
